publications.title: The Overrepresented Winner? Ethnic Minority Legislators in China's National People's Congress
publications.abstract: 描述性代表比例的提升是否会增强实质性代表效果？在全球范围内，少数民族在立法机构中通常处于代表性不足的状态。但在中国全国人民代表大会中，少数民族却呈现“超额代表”的特征。本文发现，这种“超额代表”并未转化为更强的实质性代表效果。与汉族代表相比，少数民族代表提出议案的活跃度更低，在提交政策建议方面并无显著差异，且在民族议题上表现得较为谨慎。在代表团内征集足够签名以提出议案，以及在跨代表团间构建政策联盟时，少数民族代表面临诸多挑战。代表团内部的民族多样性可能削弱其推动政策议程的能力。我们的发现表明，制度性约束与集体行动困境可能阻碍了少数民族代表实质性代表的实现。

publications.title: Can the Opening of High-Speed Rail Promote Household Multidimensional Relative Poverty Alleviation?
publications.authors: Yaning Hu, Haiyan Lu*, Hao Chai, Xinyang Gao
publications.abstract: Addressing poverty is paramount, aligning with the first Sustainable Development Goal focused on eradicating poverty in all its forms. While the effects of high-speed rail (HSR) on absolute poverty have been documented, its impact on relative poverty remains understudied. This paper examines the influence of HSR on household relative poverty in China through a quasi-experimental design. The main results are as follows: (1) The opening of HSR significantly reduced the household relative poverty by approximately 1.8%. (2) This alleviation effect primarily transpires through the expansion of economic activities and employment opportunities. (3) Notably, the impact of HSR is more pronounced in lower-ranked, smaller cities and in the western regions of China. Moreover, households with migrant workers or those engaged in non-agricultural sectors derive greater benefits from HSR developments. Our results suggest that HSR opening could have contributed to China's relative poverty alleviation.

publications.title: 民族主义与战争：宏观比较的视角
publications.authors: 安德烈亚斯·威默，高昕阳（译），杨端程（校）
publications.abstract: 民族主义在现代世界中的作用日益突出。在大多数国家，民族主义的兴起与战争紧密交织，深刻塑造了国内与国际冲突。传统上，民族主义或被理解为战争的副产品，或被视为大众动员的工具。本文则主张，民族主义不仅是战争的催化剂，更是过去两个世纪以来暴力冲突（包括内战与国家间战争）背后的根本性解释因素。基于宏观历史证据，研究识别出冲突的“双波模式”：第一波由帝国主义扩张与大规模征服战争驱动；第二波则源于挑战帝国统治的民族主义运动的兴起，引发分离主义战争与国家间对抗。两个当代案例研究进一步表明，民族国家内部的族群政治排斥如何引发内战，跨境族群纽带又如何触发国家间冲突。文章最后强调，由民族主义引发的战争并非不可避免：权力分享与同化等机制为缓解族群不平等、降低冲突风险提供了可行路径。

publications.title: 官僚制
publications.venue: 载王正绪、耿曙、唐世平主编：《比较政治学（第二版）》，复旦大学出版社

workingPapers.title: When Political Consumerism Turns Inward: A Survey Experiment on the Punishment of Domestic Brands in China
workingPapers.abstract: Political consumerism is usually directed outward: consumers boycott firms they oppose and buycott firms they endorse. Using an online survey experiment in China (N = 1,100) built around the Xinjiang cotton controversy, we ask whether it can also turn inward. Respondents strongly favored a fictional domestic brand over a matched foreign brand at baseline, yet official-media news accusing the domestic brand of exploiting patriotic sentiment produced the sharpest shift in the experiment, moving support toward the foreign alternative, raising anger and anxiety, and reducing pride; exploratory analyses suggest consumer ethnocentrism buffered the shift without reversing it. National identity, these results suggest, operates not only as a shield for domestic brands but as a standard they can fail. Brand nationality shapes what political news means to consumers, and domestic status can become a liability as well as an asset.

workingPapers.title: Augmenting Research Ideation with Data: An Empirical Investigation in Social Science
workingPapers.authors: Xiao Liu, Xinyi Dong, Xinyang Gao, Yansong Feng*, Xun Pang*
workingPapers.abstract: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong potential for generating novel research ideas, yet such ideas often struggle with feasibility and effectiveness. In this paper, we investigate whether augmenting LLMs with relevant data during the ideation process can improve idea quality. Our framework integrates data at two stages: (1) incorporating metadata during idea generation to guide models toward more feasible concepts, and (2) introducing an automated preliminary validation step during idea selection to assess the empirical plausibility of hypotheses within ideas. We evaluate our approach in the social science domain, with a specific focus on climate negotiation topics. Expert evaluation shows that metadata improves the feasibility of generated ideas by 20%, while automated validation improves the overall quality of selected ideas by 7%. Beyond assessing the quality of LLM-generated ideas, we conduct a human study to examine whether these ideas, augmented with related data and preliminary validation, can inspire researchers in their own ideation. Participants report that the LLM-generated ideas and validation are highly useful, and the ideas they propose with such support are proven to be of higher quality than those proposed without assistance. Our findings highlight the potential of data-augmented research ideation and underscore the practical value of LLM-assisted ideation in real-world academic settings.

workingPapers.title: Looks Like a Representative? Facial Impressions and Representative Activity in China
workingPapers.authors: Xinyang Gao, Weilin Xiao, Songpo Yang*
workingPapers.abstract: Facial impressions shape political selection, but do people who look suited to office also represent more actively once they hold it? We argue that the relationship depends partly on the purposes for which representatives are chosen. We study China’s local people’s congresses, using a model trained on human ratings to score portraits of 4,565 provincial deputies. Deputies have higher perceived competence and trustworthiness than governing officials. Within the congress, however, deputies with higher perceived competence are less likely to submit policy suggestions and submit fewer overall. Perceived trustworthiness, aggressiveness, and attractiveness have no significant association with suggestion activity. The negative participation association appears among government-employed deputies, while the estimate for deputies outside government is close to zero. These findings indicate an impression associated with political advancement can accompany less use of the channels of representation.

workingPapers.title: “Iron Girls” Go Home: Socialist Institutional Legacies and the Gendered Costs of Market Transition in China
workingPapers.abstract: How do socialist institutional legacies shape the distributional consequences of market transition? While modernization theory predicts that markets reduce ascriptive inequality, post-communist states witness paradoxical regression in female labor force participation (FLFP). We propose an institutional-dependence theory: because gender equality under state socialism was sustained by administrative intervention rather than endogenous development, deeper welfare-state penetration left women dependent on institutional protection and vulnerable to state retreat. We test this argument using China's 1990s marketization reform, leveraging the “Third Front Construction” campaign as a quasi-experiment for exogenous variation in pre-reform danwei (work unit) intensity. Using difference-in-differences and instrumental variable designs on county-level census data (1982–2000), we find that regions with extensive danwei legacies experienced significantly larger widening of the gender labor gap, driven by discriminatory public-sector displacement and re-familialization of care work. These findings challenge linear modernization narratives, highlighting how socialist institutional legacies condition the gendered costs of market transition.

workingPapers.title: Sorting the Outside World: Chinese Views of Foreign Countries, 1998–2023
workingPapers.abstract: Is the Chinese public turning against the outside world, or sorting it into increasingly distinct geopolitical positions? Generalized cooling would weaken the domestic basis for international engagement, whereas geopolitical sorting would harden attitudes toward rivals while preserving support for favored states. We examine thirteen probability-based waves of the Beijing Area Study from 1998 to 2023, using a fixed battery of evaluations of the United States, Russia, Japan, Germany, and North Korea. We conceptualize foreign-country attitudes as an evaluative architecture with a common evaluative level and a relational structure defined by relative position, differentiation, and direction. Evaluative level shows no continuous decline, providing little evidence of sustained generalized cooling. Instead, the central transformation is geopolitical sorting: the United States loses relative standing as Russia and North Korea gain it, and since the late 2010s, evaluations have remained organized around a persistent Russia–North Korea versus United States–Japan contrast. Associational evidence links this structure to an identity-based orientation toward the nation and a threat-based appraisal of the external environment. Combining rare longitudinal data with a new framework, the study shows how Chinese public opinion sorts foreign states into partners and rivals amid intensifying international competition.

workingPapers.title: AI Risks, Citizen Stakes, and Public Support for AI Development: Evidence from Two Survey Experiments in Beijing
workingPapers.authors: Xinyang Gao, Weilin Xiao, Xiao Ma*
workingPapers.abstract: When do artificial intelligence (AI) risks shape public support for AI development? We argue that public attitudes toward AI development reflect both the type of risk and whether citizens can interpret it and perceive a meaningful stake. We test this argument using a conjoint experiment and a vignette experiment conducted in Beijing. In the conjoint experiment, AI systems associated with high unemployment risk were less likely to be chosen by respondents with prior AI experience, especially employed respondents who felt insecure about their jobs. Ethical safeguards, by contrast, did not consistently affect choices between AI systems. In the vignette experiment, an integrated AI-risk vignette increased worry and vigilance without raising average support for strict regulation. Yet its effect on regulatory preference increased with concern about AI replacing human work, highlighting a distinction between affective response and policy preference. This framework links algorithmic governance to the political economy of technological change by specifying the conditions under which AI risks translate into opposition to or constraints on AI development.

workingPapers.title: 政府预警为何失灵？基于灾害性天气预警的调查实验
workingPapers.abstract: 政府预警为何难以转化为公众的有效避险？随着极端灾害性天气频发，预警信号已经成为风险治理的关键工具。通过两阶段调查实验，本研究探讨了灾害性天气预警信息对公众避险遵从意向以及风险感知的影响。研究发现：第一，当预警信号包含政策指引及权威信源时，公众的避险遵从意向均难以有效改变。第二，公众对不同权威信源的认知加工存在显著差异，因而其避险遵从意向呈现一种“权威悖论”：权威信源虽能显著提升公众对政府风险应对能力的信心，但因公众的情感反应差异而诱发“安全错觉”，其避险遵从意向不升反降。第三，预警信息与公众即时体感之间的偏差也会影响公众对政府应对风险的信心。相较于其他治理主体，基层权威的信誉资源最为脆弱。本研究揭示了风险沟通中“认知—行为”转化逻辑的复杂性，对优化超大型城市风险治理具有现实启示。
